en-US.description: RadioMaximus is a radio application for Windows. It features tabbed radios, a powerful radio search, a highly customizable interface.
en-US.longDescription:
RadioMaximus is a feature-rich software application for Windows that serves as an Internet radio player, recorder, and organizer.
It is designed for users who want a powerful tool to discover, listen to, and automatically record music from thousands of online radio stations.

Key Features:
- Massive Station Database: Accesses a vast, built-in directory of tens of thousands of internet radio stations, easily searchable by genre, country, or language.
- Advanced Recording: Its core strength is the sophisticated automatic recording功能. Users can schedule recordings, set rules to capture specific songs or artists (using title filters), and avoid duplicates.
- Music Library Management: Automatically organizes recorded tracks into a searchable music library, extracting and storing ID3 tags (artist, title, album) for easy sorting and playback.
- Audio Quality & Formats: Allows users to choose the recording quality and format (e.g., MP3, WMA, OGG, FLAC).
- Skins and Plugins: Supports custom skins to change its appearance and plugins to extend its functionality.
- Sleep Timer & Alarms: Includes standard features like a sleep timer to stop playback and an alarm to start it.

14-Day Free Trial: If you have not registered yet, the download runs as 14-day trial version free of charge. The trial is fully functional with.
